title: Mama's Enchiladas
imagePrompt: Rolled flour tortillas sit seam-side down in a tight row, blanketed in brick-red enchilada sauce that has soaked into the tortilla edges and pooled in the gaps. A thick layer of cheddar has melted into a glossy, golden-orange blanket with a few lightly browned, bubbly spots. Where a portion is lifted, the filling shows shredded chicken, yellow corn kernels, black beans, and bits of green chile, with the soft tortillas slightly steamed and tender rather than crisp.
subtitle: Slow cooker chicken, corn, and black bean enchiladas under red sauce and melted cheddar.

ingredients.heading: Ingredients
ingredients.note: Dump-and-roll dinner: the slow cooker does the baking.
items: 1 (10-oz) can enchilada sauce (divided: ¼ cup bottom, ½ cup filling, rest on top)
2 cups rotisserie chicken, shredded
½ cup salsa
1 cup frozen corn, thawed
1 (15-oz) can black beans, drained and rinsed
1 (4-oz) can mild green chiles (with juices)
12 flour tortillas, fajita-size
2 cups shredded cheddar cheese
Nonstick cooking spray
ingredients.callout: Key rule: Tuck paper towels under the lid so condensation doesn't drip onto the cheese and make the tortillas soggy.

substitutes: Red enchilada sauce, any heat level

body.html: Shredded chicken, corn, black beans, and green chiles rolled in flour tortillas, then slow-cooked under enchilada sauce and cheddar. Almost entirely hands-off once assembled.

items: Mise en place — shred chicken, thaw corn, drain beans, measure sauce, and spray the slow cooker
Sauce the bottom of the slow cooker
Mix the filling with chicken, salsa, corn, beans, chiles, and sauce
Fill and roll 12 tortillas
Layer, sauce, and cheese the enchiladas
Cook on low 3–4 hours with paper towels under the lid

body.html: Tip: Paper towels under the lid absorb condensation so the cheese stays melty, not watery.

items: Shred 2 cups rotisserie chicken and thaw 1 cup frozen corn.
Drain and rinse the 15-oz can black beans; open the green chiles (keep the juices).
Measure ½ cup salsa and open the 10-oz can enchilada sauce.
Shred 2 cups cheddar if not pre-shredded.
Coat a 6-quart slow cooker with nonstick spray; set out a large bowl, spoon, and paper towels.

body.html: Thaw the corn fully: Frozen corn straight in drops the temperature and adds extra water.

slides.title: Sauce the Slow Cooker
slides.checkboxLabel: Spray cooker, pour ¼ cup sauce on bottom

items: Make sure the 6-quart slow cooker is well coated with nonstick spray.
Pour ¼ cup enchilada sauce across the bottom and spread it out.

body.html: Why: The sauce layer keeps the bottom tortillas from sticking and scorching.

slides.title: Mix the Filling
slides.checkboxLabel: Combine filling in a large bowl

items: In a large bowl, combine chicken, salsa, corn, black beans, and green chiles with their juices.
Stir in ½ cup enchilada sauce until everything is evenly coated.
Spoon about ¼ cup filling down the center of each tortilla.
Roll up tightly.
Place seam-side down in the slow cooker, tucking them snugly in rows. Stack a second layer if needed.

body.html: Don't overfill: About ¼ cup keeps the rolls closed and lets all 12 use up the filling evenly.

slides.title: Sauce + Cheese
slides.checkboxLabel: Pour on remaining sauce, add cheddar

items: Pour the remaining enchilada sauce evenly over the enchiladas, covering any exposed tortilla.
Sprinkle 2 cups cheddar over the top.

slides.title: Slow Cook
slides.checkboxLabel: Paper towels under lid, cook on low 3–4 hrs

items: Lay 2–3 paper towels across the top of the slow cooker, then set the lid on top.
Cook on low for 3–4 hours until bubbling and the cheese is fully melted.
Serve straight from the cooker with a spatula.

body.html: Doneness cue: Sauce bubbling at the edges and cheese melted through. Don't lift the lid early; it lets heat and steam escape.
